Verified per-site (RFC 0106): `create_through_record(record, save)` (has_one_through_association.rb:10-12) writes the join row, so it is async in trails. `replace` cannot be — it is reached from the synchronous `writer`/`setNewRecord` path that RFC 0087 requires to stay sync — so the body queues `_pendingReplace` and `persistReplace`/`autosaveHasOne` awaits `createThroughRecord` one frame later. Same sync-setter shortcoming as the `setX()` idiom.
